adjudication.rationale: In `packages/app-store/_utils/oauth/parseRefreshTokenResponse.ts`, `parseRefreshTokenResponse` returns the result of `schema.safeParse(...)` (a `SafeParseReturnType` with `{ success, data, error }`), not the parsed token object itself. In `packages/app-store/googlecalendar/lib/CalendarService.ts`, the code sets `const key = parseRefreshTokenResponse(googleCredentials, googleCredentialSchema);` and then persists it via `prisma.credential.update({ data: { key } })`. This would store the wrapper object instead of the credentials payload, corrupting `credential.key` on refresh.
